rtlComponentFindings.element: Back / Exit button and Language selector dropdown
rtlComponentFindings.directionalIssue: Uses left-aligned layout and hardcoded margin-right classes (`mr-2`)
rtlComponentFindings.recommendation: Replace with Tailwind CSS logical spacing (`me-2`, `ms-2`) and wrap icons with RTL flip helper

rtlComponentFindings.directionalIssue: Fills from left to right by default; in RTL, quantitative bar should stay LTR
rtlComponentFindings.recommendation: Explicitly force `dir='ltr'` on quantitative progress track or apply CSS logical `inset-inline-start`

rtlComponentFindings.directionalIssue: Mathematical equations and numeric fractions must remain LTR in Arabic and Hebrew
rtlComponentFindings.recommendation: Enclose all math rendering containers and formula slots in `<bdi dir='ltr'>`

rtlComponentFindings.directionalIssue: `ChevronRight` points forward in LTR, but in RTL points backward
